fine.selection: Top two coarse points by paired mean among nonzero-override policies. Always finish the declared sample; no stop on passing CI.

score_gate: Heldout 95% CI lower bound > 0 and observed overrides; 2048 games is exploratory and does not replace the existing 4096-game rollout gate.
rust_decision: Only if heldout benefit is established and performance gates fail.

confirmation.reason: Correct prior dealer allocation asymmetry and 15.625ms monotonic timing resolution; original coarse/fine are exploratory only.
confirmation.candidate: Coarse prechosen conservative point; no profile change

ablation.baseline: Same profile with plus_one disabled; opponents remain production
